children: may break support at $102.68 per barrel and fall into the $99.46-$101.24 range.

The contract failed twice to break a resistance at $105.90. These failures suggest a double-top formation, which is likely to be confirmed, as the market briefly pierced below the neckline support at $102.68.
The pattern will become valid once support breaks. It will suggest a target of $99.46. Immediate resistance is at $104.12, a break above which may lead to a gain to $105.90.

On the daily chart, the market faces a resistance at $105.88. The spinning top on Oct. 9 signals fading bullish momentum. The contract is more likely to fall toward $98 than to break $105.88 and rise to $110.24.
The degree of the current correction increases the chance of a fall, which might be as deep as the one from $102.
